title: National BIM mandates: regulatory status by jurisdiction
description:
Regulatory status of BIM (building information modelling) requirements in 59 jurisdictions — mandatory, partial or voluntary — with the IFC (ISO 16739) schema requirement, the professional-qualification landscape and a link to the official primary source for every entry (95 sources). Last reviewed 14 June 2026.

Interactive map: World BIM Mandates Map.
